orthologr

2026-10-19

Source: vignettes/orthologr.Rmd
orthologr.Rmd

orthologr infers orthologous genes between genomes, estimates their dN/dS, and clusters proteins into homologous groups, all without leaving the R environment. Four steps get you started.

1. Install orthologr 

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
BiocManager::install(c("Biostrings", "GenomicRanges", "GenomicFeatures",
                       "Rsamtools", "rtracklayer", "pwalign"))
install.packages(c("doParallel", "foreach", "ape", "Rdpack", "benchmarkme", "devtools"))
devtools::install_github("drostlab/metablastr")
devtools::install_github("drostlab/orthologr")

Windows users also need Rtools.

2. Install DIAMOND2 

library(orthologr)
diamond_install()

This downloads DIAMOND2 for your operating system into a user cache folder, with no administrator rights or PATH changes. It is the only external tool needed for steps 3 and 4. See Install for alternatives (conda, manual install, BLAST+).

3. Estimate dN/dS with dNdS()

dNdS() finds orthologous gene pairs between two species and computes dN, dS and dN/dS for each pair from their coding sequences.

dnds <- dNdS(
  query_file     = system.file("seqs/ortho_thal_cds.fasta", package = "orthologr"),
  subject_file   = system.file("seqs/ortho_lyra_cds.fasta", package = "orthologr"),
  print_citation = FALSE
)
#>

#> subject = 'ortho_lyra_cds.fasta'

4. Cluster proteins with deepclust()

deepclust() groups the proteins of one or more proteomes into homologous clusters.

clusters <- deepclust(
  input_file = c(
    system.file("seqs/ortho_thal_aa.fasta", package = "orthologr"),
    system.file("seqs/ortho_lyra_aa.fasta", package = "orthologr")
  ),
  mutual_cover = 70 # 70% mutual coverage of the aligned sequences
)
#> Running diamond version 2.2.1 ...
#> Merging 2 input files ...
#> Merged 40 sequences into: deepclust_merged_2_files.fasta
#> Building DIAMOND2 database for deepclust ...
#> Running diamond deepclust ...
#> diamond deepclust completed in 0.77 sec.

head(clusters)
